title: Sum over a flattened list
statement: Let $l$ be a finite list, let $g$ assign a finite list to each element of its type, and let $F$ map the elements of those lists to integers. The sum of $F$ over the concatenation of the lists $g(x)$ for $x\in l$ equals the sum, over $x\in l$, of the sum of $F$ over $g(x)$.
hypotheses_covered: $g$ maps each element to a list
